checklist.notes: The lesson aligns with socially suitable requests but cannot address the full authoritative objective because narration and mediation are absent from, and forbidden by, this lesson’s reconstructed allocation.
For its narrower request-pragmatics target, the bounded situation, contrastive models, rehearsal, recording, and checklist are viable for self-study.
It consolidates request wording and word stress, but cannot consolidate the preceding lesson’s narration or mediation work despite its application/review position.
The visible facts, friend/staff contrast, dialogue, word-stress marking, and final checks are clear.
The narrower request, register, assessment, and word-stress workload is manageable for A2.1 and 35 minutes.
The practical transit exchange and explicit stress marking are usable without asserting that all Vietnamese learners share a difficulty.
The sections cohere around requests, but the resulting lesson does not cohere with the full M5 objective or its declared consolidation of the preceding narration-and-mediation lesson.

findings.description: M5 requires this lesson to “handle narration, mediation, and socially suitable requests,” while the hash-matched request allocates only request-help, word stress, polite-request pragmatics, and request assessment. It does not allocate grammar, narrative sequencing, or mediation; concept_mediation and the relevant narrative resources are forbidden. The generator therefore cannot lawfully satisfy the conjunction in the objective.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the M5 architecture before regeneration: either narrow this lesson’s objective/review claim to socially suitable request performance, or explicitly allocate authorized narration and mediation targets. Do not ask the generator to use currently forbidden content.

methods: Inspected the lesson against its reconstructed, hash-matched M5 teaching payload and confirmed that no external source payload was supplied.
Compared wording and examples across the closed set of all ten revised lessons for suspicious verbatim duplication beyond shared instructional scaffolding.
Reviewed the audit provenance/copyright result and source-scope constraints as machine evidence without treating them as a web-wide originality check.
copyright_originality_check.scope_limitations: Closed-corpus review of the ten supplied lessons plus their exact M5/request/audit context only; no Internet-wide search, external proprietary corpus, legal opinion, or provider receipt was available.

limitations: This is an independent AI pedagogical review for development evidence only; it is not human review, release approval, certification, or publication authorization.
The governing M5 snapshot retains DRAFT taxonomy and OUTLINE_ONLY curriculum records and is limited to the development lane.
No learner trial, classroom observation, or outcome study was performed.
No audio was supplied, so no acoustic, listening-performance, or pronunciation-performance review was performed.
Originality checking was closed-corpus and artifact-bound; no web-wide plagiarism search, external corpus comparison, or legal determination was performed.
Generation provider provenance was not independently established; UNKNOWN is retained rather than inferred.
Generator reasoning, self-assessment, and prior review records were not inspected.
response.sha256 hashes the canonical UTF-8 JSON of the decision, checklist, findings, copyright_originality_check, and limitations captured in this session.
